reader.requirement: At 1985 (Amendment 1 applied) LENGTH, RANDOM and SUM are both reserved words and function-names, classified by context (FUNCTION LENGTH/RANDOM/SUM work beside ACCESS MODE RANDOM and the SUM clause), and none of the three may be used as any user-defined word (data-name, condition-name, paragraph/section-name, file-name, program-name, mnemonic-, alphabet-, class-, index-name, text-name, library-name) or as a system-name (computer-name). The witnesses cover only the COPY text-name position.

edition-consulted.switches: whether the word is reserved at the compiled edition year (generated table ReservedWords.Table.cs: LENGTH, RANDOM, SUM reserved at 85, 2002, 2014, 2023, confidence high)

the reservation via RejectsAt(word, edition) and, through EditionContext.CopyNamesAreUserDefinedWords, only the message: at 85 a text-/library-name is a user-defined word, from 2002 a system-name; the refusal is the same
RejectsAt(word, edition year) for a reserved word written in a user-word slot (COBOL0901)
parser gate: a token whose canonical word RejectsAt the edition is not a user word

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the three words are reserved and function-names at every edition; only the COPY-name message wording differs (user-defined word at 85, system-name from 2002)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: only the COPY text-name position; data-, condition-, paragraph-, section-, file-, program-, mnemonic-, alphabet-, class-, index-, library-name, computer-name and the function-name half are not exercised

reader.notes: Every user-defined-word and system-name position probed refuses LENGTH, RANDOM and SUM at --std 85, and the three still work as function-names and in their reserved-word contexts. Several positions (file-, mnemonic-, class-, index-name, computer-name) are refused by the parser with COBOL5506/COBOL1971 'unexpected' rather than COBOL0901; the refusal is correct, only the diagnostic wording is less specific.

refuter.evidence: Probed at --std 85 the positions the reader left out; each compile-only refuses: symbolic-character LENGTH (r2-symchar: COBOL0901), report-name SUM in FD REPORT IS and RD (r2-report: COBOL5506 at both; control r2-report-ctl with OKREP exit 0), report group data-name LENGTH (r2-rptdata: COBOL0901), cd-name RANDOM (r2-cd: COBOL5506), CD field data-name SUM (r2-cdkey: COBOL5506 and COBOL0901), 66 RANDOM RENAMES (r2-renames: COBOL0901), implementor-name position SUM IS MN1 (r2-implementor: COBOL1970). Every user-defined word class of 1985 and the system-name positions are now refused; the function-name half was shown by the reader's c2-pos. The reader's cite.py lines for SR2a/SR2b stand.
